question: Will Darline Graham Nordone be the new republican nominee for Senate in South Carolina?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the special Republican Primary for United States Senator from South Carolina, including any potential runoff.

If no 2026 special South Carolina Republican Senate Primary takes place by November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the candidate who is the official Republican nominee to contest the November 3, 2026 South Carolina U.S. Senate election.

If the results of the special primary are not definitively known, or if there is no Republican nominee to contest the November 3, 2026 South Carolina U.S. Senate election, by November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the South Carolina Republican party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.
research:
As of 2026-08-12, the race is down to a runoff on August 25 between Sen. Darline Graham Nordone and Rep. Ralph Norman. She finished first in the August 11 special primary, with about 32.7% to Norman's 24.6%, but short of the majority needed to win outright. Most of the pages wouldn't load, so many figures below come from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the South Carolina Republican Party's first announcement of the special GOP primary winner, including any runoff. Credible reporting, such as AP race calls, may also count. I could not open any SCGOP or State Election Commission results page.
- 2026-08-11/12: Unofficial results from WCSC/Live 5: Darline Graham Nordone 32.7% (109,582 votes), Ralph Norman 24.6%, Russell Fry 19.6%, Mark Sanford 14.9%, Mark Lynch 5.9%. Ten candidates ran in total. [Live 5](https://www.live5news.com/2026/08/12/election-results-sc-special-republican-senate-primary/)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-11: The AP called it for Graham and Norman, who advance to the runoff. South Carolina requires a runoff when no candidate tops 50%. Turnout was just over 11% of registered voters. [SC Daily Gazette](https://scdailygazette.com/2026/08/11/darline-graham-advances-to-runoff-in-special-gop-primary-its-unclear-who-shell-face/), [Local10/AP](https://www.local10.com/news/politics/2026/08/11/sen-darline-graham-us-rep-ralph-norman-advance-to-gop-runoff-for-us-senate-in-south-carolina/), [NPR/WLRN](https://www.wlrn.org/national-politics/2026-08-11/in-south-carolina-sen-darline-graham-advances-to-a-gop-special-primary-runoff-for-us-senate)
- **Nothing is settled yet.** It is a two-person runoff, and she is ahead going in. Norman edged Fry for second place in a close race.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-11: Graham Nordone and Norman advance to the runoff. Sanford finished fourth. [ABC News 4](https://abcnews4.com/news/local/darline-graham-ralph-norman-advance-in-sc-special-us-senate-primary)
- 2026-08-10: AP preview describes the field as two congressmen (Norman, Fry), former Gov. Mark Sanford and Graham's sister. [Local10/AP](https://www.local10.com/news/politics/2026/08/10/ap-decision-notes-what-to-expect-in-south-carolinas-special-primary-to-replace-sen-lindsey-graham/)
- 2026-07-20/21: She announces she will run for the full term. FITSNews said she had a cool reception from GOP voters and early polls showed her trailing the field. [Deseret](https://www.deseret.com/politics/2026/07/21/darline-graham-nordone-announces-she-will-run-for-senate/), [FITSNews](https://www.fitsnews.com/2026/07/20/s-c-succession-drama-darline-graham-nordone-will-seek-full-term-in-u-s-senate/)
- 2026-07-17: Trump endorses her in the special election. Reporting says he recruited her and later campaigned for her. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/17/trump-darline-graham-nordone-senate-endorsement), [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/trump-backs-darline-graham-nordone-primary-replace-lindsey-graham-rcna588075)
- 2026-07-13: Gov. Henry McMaster appoints her as interim senator after Sen. Lindsey Graham died on July 11. [Fox Carolina](https://www.foxcarolina.com/2026/07/13/beautiful-tribute-sc-leaders-react-darline-graham-being-named-interim-senator-after-brothers-death/), [Bloomberg Gov](https://news.bgov.com/bloomberg-government-news/grahams-sister-appointed-to-us-senate-two-days-after-his-death)
- The Democratic nominee is Dr. Annie Andrews, who won the June primary.

## 4. Base rates
- I found no systematic study of South Carolina runoffs. The general pattern in Southern GOP runoffs is that the first-round leader usually, but not always, wins. A Trump endorsement has been a strong predictor in recent GOP primaries.
- Her first-round lead was about 8 points (32.7% vs 24.6%). The combined share of candidates who are now eliminated was about 43%: Fry 19.6%, Sanford 14.9%, Lynch 5.9% and others. I found no endorsements from Fry or Sanford as of 2026-08-12.
- Pre-primary polls were mixed:
  - Trafalgar (Aug 8-10): Graham 26.4, Norman 19.5, Fry 18.4, Sanford 18.3.
  - Emerson: Norman 22, Graham 19.
  - Quantus: Graham 33, Norman 20, Fry 20.
  - co/efficient: Graham 30, Fry 16, Norman 15.
  
  These come from a search summary. [Washington Examiner](https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/?p=4680256), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/darline-graham-chances-losing-republican-primary-brothers-senate-seat-12304450)
- I found no head-to-head runoff poll dated on or before 2026-08-12.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-13: After Trump's recommendation, Kalshi odds that she would be appointed to the seat jumped from 15% to 94.7% within 17 minutes. [Daily Wire](https://www.dailywire.com/news/lindsey-grahams-sister-named-interim-senator-she-accepted-through-tears)
- An aggregator lists Kalshi contracts on the runoff, but the page has no timestamp, so I can't date its prices. [simplefunctions.dev](https://simplefunctions.dev/congress/G000608)
- **I could not find any Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price for the runoff dated on or before 2026-08-12.**

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-25: The Graham Nordone vs. Norman runoff. Results and an AP call are expected that night. The SCGOP announcement is the resolution source.
- Before then, watch for:
  - endorsements from Fry or Sanford
  - Trump rallies or messaging (he has endorsed her)
  - runoff polling
  - turnout, which was low in the first round at about 11%
- If there were a recount or a dispute, results could be delayed, but the November 2 deadline leaves plenty of time.
